item.title: Dangerous narrow exit, 11th August
item.description:
The exit from Highbury Mews onto Priory street is very narrow with cars parked very close on either side of the exit. There are 11 properties that are accessed via Highbury Mews and constantly there are near misses pulling out. You have to edge out very very slowly and hope that the person coming down the road is also going very slowly but a number of residents have almost had a accident and there have generally been incidences of drivers on Priory Street swearing and shouting at residents trying to pull out who have done nothing wrong but are just unable to see what they are pulling out into.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 1, Highbury Mews, Ewens Farm, Cheltenham, Cheltenham
Report on FixMyStreet

item.title: Inappropriate location for dog waste bin, 11th August
item.description:
The dog waste bin outside Uckington and Elmstone Hardwicke Village Hall is poorly located. It is currently situated on a grassy slope which is slippery when wet and thus creates a safety hazard. In addition it cannot be accessed by owners with mobility issues. It would be better located on flat ground by the fence of the village hall car park approximately 15 metres to the right at what3words location angel.usual.wisdom. See attached photos. Many thanks.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Tewkesbury
